title: Find the short name of the team that lost the fewest home matches in the 'G
question: Find the short name of the team that lost the fewest home matches in the 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' during August to October 2008 and has team attributes with a build-up play speed of 60 or higher.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_174
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.XCL_171 = T2.XCL_177
INNER JOIN Match AS T3 ON T1.XCL_171 = T3.XCL_013
INNER JOIN League AS T4 ON T3.XCL_008 = T4.XCL_003
WHERE T4.XCL_005 = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND SUBSTRING(T3.XCL_011, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'
  AND T2.XCL_179 >= 60
  AND T3.XCL_016 < T3.XCL_015
GROUP BY T1.XCL_171
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_174
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.XCL_171 = T2.XCL_177
INNER JOIN Match AS T3 ON T1.XCL_171 = T3.XCL_013
INNER JOIN League AS T4 ON T3.XCL_008 = T4.XCL_003
WHERE T4.XCL_005 = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND SUBSTRING(T3.XCL_011, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'
  AND T2.XCL_179 >= 60
  AND T3.XCL_016 < T3.XCL_015
GROUP BY T1.XCL_171
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1
